methodology.source: triverna.pl hotel page, date-picker calendar grid + 'Do zaplaty brutto' total
methodology.calendar_trick: Click the arrival date field -> calendar shows nightly rates for the whole month. Arrow forward for subsequent months. One zoom = one month.
methodology.room_param_note: CORRECTION to prompt section 3.5: no room= URL param is needed. The widget initialises fully once BOTH dates and OSOB>=1 are set; the room radio list then appears in the widget. Bare slug works.
methodology.counter_timing: CORRECTION to prompt section 3.4: the 'Do zaplaty brutto' counter takes ~45-60 SECONDS to settle, not 6-8. Observed Carynska 565 -> 641 -> 770 -> 939 -> 1057 -> 1108 -> 1110 over ~50s; Bachledka 849 -> 1390 -> 1673 -> 1815 -> 1830 over ~55s. Reading early understates the price by up to 50%. Poll until two consecutive reads match.
methodology.caution: Calendar cell = lowest nightly rate of the CHEAPEST room in the offer, not necessarily the room that fits 3. Formulas below convert calendar rates to the real total.
